One more repo was created that will act as podcast generator that will create podcast(s) calling same action feed.py
githubactions-podcast-generator
with ReadMe.md and License = MIT License
copy the same feed.py from "githubactions-podcast-test" into this new repo

Note: however i faced few issues in invoking githubactions-podcast-generator - python version conflict in Dockerfile

for that replace the contents of main.yml with below:

name: Generate Podcast Feeds
'on': push
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Run Feed Generator
        uses: MahanteshTalikoti-git/githubactions-podcast-generator@master
